episodes.title: Part I
episodes.summary: Bass rides into hell. Esau makes a violent impression on Bass. Bass escapes his chains, but has to make a hard sacrifice.

episodes.title: Part II
episodes.summary: Bass and his family endure tough times on their farm. Bass gets a visit from the law and is faced with an interesting proposition.

episodes.title: Part III
episodes.summary: Bass is sworn in and embarks on his first mission as a U.S. Deputy Marshal; the Underwood gang strikes after Bass is let in on a secret...

episodes.title: Part IV
episodes.summary: Bass and his new posse man have a fateful encounter at the Women's Boarding House. Jennie reunites with someone from her past.

episodes.title: Part V
episodes.summary: After pandemonium erupts at Bywater's store, Bass is forced to choose between his oath and family. Sally runs into trouble at the carnival, while Bass confronts an old nemesis.

episodes.title: Part VI
episodes.summary: Chaos ensues as a firefight breaks out in Checotah. Bass and Jennie have a painful reunion. Bass has an unsettling realization as the myth of Mister Sundown lives on.

episodes.title: Part VII
episodes.summary: Bass struggles with the weight of the badge like never before. After a deadly mission goes awry, the U.S. Deputy Marshal's fate is left in the hands of someone else.

episodes.title: Part VIII
episodes.summary: After a waltz with the devil, Bass, Billy Crow, and Sherrill have a dangerous reckoning with Mister Sundown. Meanwhile, trouble ensues for Jennie, Sally, and Esme back at the Reeves' farm.
